visualCharacteristics.purpose: dated, expiring deal list with search, Category/Brand facets and sorting
visualCharacteristics.description: Left sidebar (~1/4): 'N Specials' heading, Search input with icon button, collapsible Category and Brand checkbox groups (no counts), red Clear Filters button. Right: 'Sort By:' select above a vertical list of deal cards; each card has the uppercase title, '<N> Redemption Limit' and 'Valid through MM/DD/YYYY' at the left and a large '$<amount> OFF' at the right ('$' superscripted, 'OFF' smaller). Cards alternate white with a 1px #333 border and dark grey #58595b with white text. Mobile: count, then a Filter toggle revealing search/facets/Clear Filters, then Sort By and the list.

contentPattern.structure: one row per deal, 1 cell: H3 title; '<N> Redemption Limit'; 'Valid through MM/DD/YYYY'; '$<amount> OFF'; last line 'Category: <names, comma separated> | Brand: <brand> | Starts: MM/DD/YYYY' (Brand and Starts optional)
contentPattern.notes: Lines are recognized by pattern, not position; unknown extra paragraphs render under the title. The tag line is not rendered; category names that contain commas ('Body, Cab, & Chassis', 'Fluids, Lubricants, & Chemicals') are recognized as known names before splitting on commas. The block builds the count, search (title and category names), facets (OR within a group, AND between groups; Category in the source facet order, unknown names appended alphabetically; only values used by a current deal), Clear Filters, Sort By (Default, Discount high/low, A-Z, Z-A, Expiring Soon) and the mobile Filter toggle. A deal is hidden after the end of its valid-through day and before its Starts day (local time); with no current deals the block shows 'No current deals.'. No pagination.

suitableFor: lists of dated, expiring offers or coupons with an amount off
long lists that need keyword search, category/brand filters and sorting
notSuitableFor: short promotional card grids (use cards or cards-offers)
lists without 'Category: ...' tag lines (facets would be empty)
